<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="2" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="27" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="18" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="325" y1="17" x2="329" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="332" y1="14" x2="332" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="11" x2="336" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="8" x2="340" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="354" y1="9" x2="354" y2="6" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="11" x2="348" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="358" y1="11" x2="360" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="7" width="18" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="371" y="9" width="13" height="8" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="387" y="11" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header controls -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="27" width="390" height="58" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,56 23,63 31,70" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="63" x2="40" y2="63" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="61" y="53" width="268" height="12" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="61" y="53" width="107" height="12" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <text x="195" y="63" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Step 2 of 5</text>
    <rect x="345" y="47" width="28" height="23" rx="7" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <polygon points="349,51 369,51 369,66 359,61 349,66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="359" y1="50" x2="359" y2="67" stroke="#FF4B4B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="119" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Tell us about your trip</text>
    <text x="22" y="145" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">We’ll build lessons around where you’re going.</text>

    <!-- Destination field -->
    <text x="22" y="178" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Where are you going?</text>
    <rect x="21" y="188" width="348" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="45" cy="214" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="45" y1="205" x2="45" y2="223" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="214" x2="54" y2="214" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="65" y="220" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">City or country</text>
    <text x="22" y="260" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Add a destination to personalize your vocabulary.</text>

    <!-- Date fields -->
    <text x="22" y="291" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">When is your trip?</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="21" y="301" width="166" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="38" y="316" width="16" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="38" y1="321" x2="54" y2="321" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="42" y1="312" x2="42" y2="318" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="312" x2="50" y2="318" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="67" y="334" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Start date</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="203" y="301" width="166" height="54" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="220" y="316" width="16" height="15" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="220" y1="321" x2="236" y2="321" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="224" y1="312" x2="224" y2="318" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="232" y1="312" x2="232" y2="318" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="249" y="334" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">End date</text>
    </g>
    <text x="22" y="373" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">You can change these details later.</text>

    <!-- Purpose card -->
    <text x="22" y="405" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">What will you use the language for?</text>
    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="21" y="417" width="348" height="141" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
      <rect x="21" y="415" width="348" height="141" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    </g>

    <g>
      <rect x="35" y="429" width="153" height="48" rx="13" fill="#DDF4FF" stroke="#63C9F9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="57" cy="453" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="57" y1="444" x2="57" y2="462" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="48" y1="453" x2="66" y2="453" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="75" y="459" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Getting around</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="202" y="429" width="153" height="48" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="222" cy="450" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="222" cy="461" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="239" y="459" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Meeting people</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="35" y="490" width="153" height="48" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="49" y="505" width="17" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="52" y1="502" x2="63" y2="502" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="75" y="520" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Food & drinks</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="202" y="490" width="153" height="48" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="222,501 225,509 234,509 227,514 230,522 222,517 214,522 217,514 210,509 219,509" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="241" y="520" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4B4B4C">Sightseeing</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Notes field -->
    <text x="22" y="590" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Anything else to practice?</text>
    <rect x="21" y="600" width="348" height="58" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="37" y="634" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Optional details, like a hotel or airport</text>
    <text x="22" y="681" font-family="SF Pro Text" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Your answers help us choose useful words and phrases.</text>

    <!-- Continue button -->
    <g>
      <rect x="21" y="697" width="348" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
      <text x="195" y="727" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">CONTINUE</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="756" x2="374" y2="756" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="45,779 58,768 71,779 71,793 62,793 62,784 54,784 54,793 45,793" fill="#15451F"/>
      <text x="58" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="137" cy="780" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="131,780 135,784 144,774" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="137" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Learn</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="234" cy="777" r="5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <ellipse cx="234" cy="790" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="234" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="326" cy="780" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <circle cx="326" cy="780" r="3" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <line x1="326" y1="766" x2="326" y2="770" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="326" y1="790" x2="326" y2="794" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="326" y="810" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Settings</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
